name: veterinary_clinic_system_058_visit_note_completeness_score
instruction: Produce the documentation-quality snapshot for this episode under the batch code in ops_meta. A visit record is 'complete' only if all four of its SOAP fields (subjective, objective, assessment, plan) are non-empty strings after trimming, weight_kg is a number greater than zero, and problems is a non-empty list containing at least one documented problem. Write two sets of ops_reports rows. (1) One rollup row report='note_completeness' with batch_code, total_visits, complete, incomplete, completeness_pct (round(100*complete/total,1)), and incomplete_ids (comma-joined ascending ids of incomplete rows, or '' if none). (2) One row report='note_completeness_by_provider' per provider_id that appears in visit_records, with provider_id, provider_name (from the providers join), total_visits, complete, incomplete, and completeness_pct. If any of these report rows already exist for this batch, delete and rewrite them. Do not modify visit_records or providers.
_max_steps_note: Measure via live gold run in QC session; do not guess.
_par_steps_note: Measure via live gold run in QC session; do not guess.

checks.expect: exactly 1 rollup + 4 by-provider rows for this batch
completeness counts and provider breakdown recomputed via SQL and Python; both agree

hazards: visit_records id=371 is the only row with an empty plan under the old four-field predicate, but the hardmode rule also requires a non-empty problems list. With the new rule 208 rows are incomplete (e.g., id=2,3,4 have problems:[]). A solution using only the v1 predicate under-reports incomplete and fails.
The problems field is a list of objects; treating problems:[] or a non-list as complete will under-count incomplete rows. Confirmed: rows like id=2 have 'problems': [].
Provider breakdown must join providers by id and include provider_name. Only providers 1-4 have visit_records; a solution that emits all 9 providers or omits names fails.
incomplete_ids must be a comma-joined sorted list. Confirmed: the incomplete set is 208 ids; the expected string is sorted ascending.
ops_reports must be delete-then-rewritten per batch. Duplicate or stale batch rows fail the count checks.

domain_searches.query: veterinary SOAP note completeness documentation quality score problem list
top_results: Problem oriented veterinary medical record POMR

top_results: Veterinary EMR completeness score by provider

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Hardmode v2 adds the problems-list requirement to the completeness predicate, turning a single incomplete row into 208. It adds a provider-name join and a per-provider breakdown, and uses dual-path SQL/Python verification.
